system: AgriN Unified Soil Health Standards & Nutrient Framework
source: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) & Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (DAC&FW)
applicable_region: Pan-India (applicable across Indian agro-climatic zones with regional vertisol/calcareous calibrations)
scientific_disclaimer: These critical limits and threshold ratings are established national benchmarks compiled from published ICAR and DAC&FW Soil Health Card protocols. They provide decision support and do not replace site-specific laboratory agronomist counsel.

low.action: Apply 25% extra nitrogen or incorporate green manure/legumes

high.action: Reduce chemical nitrogen by 25% to prevent leaching and vegetative lodging

P.name: Available Phosphorus
P.method: Olsen method (alkaline/neutral soil) / Bray & Kurtz No. 1 (acid soil)
P.source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Soil Science (IISS) Bhopal

low.action: Apply single superphosphate (SSP) with organic manure or PSB biofertilizer

medium.action: Apply standard recommended phosphorus at basal sowing

high.action: Withhold chemical phosphorus; utilize mycorrhiza for P mobilization

low.action: Apply Muriate of Potash (MOP) or sulphate of potash

high.action: Potash adequate; focus on micronutrient balance

low.action: Critical deficit: Apply 5-10 t/ha FYM/compost, practice crop residue retention and cover cropping

medium.action: Incorporate green manure (Dhaincha/Sunnhemp) or compost to build long-term carbon

high.action: Maintain soil biological health via minimum tillage and residue cover

pH.name: Soil Reaction
pH.source: ICAR Soil Testing in India Manual

strongly_acidic.action: Apply agricultural lime (CaCO3) based on buffer pH test; avoid acidifying fertilizers

moderately_acidic.action: Optimal for tea, coffee, potato; apply rock phosphate instead of water-soluble P

neutral.action: Ideal nutrient availability zone; maintain balanced crop nutrition

moderately_alkaline.action: Calcareous/vertisol condition; apply zinc and iron foliar sprays to counter fixation

strongly_alkaline.action: High sodicity hazard: Apply gypsum (CaSO4) followed by leaching; cultivate salt-tolerant green manure

EC.name: Electrical Conductivity
EC.source: Central Soil Salinity Research Institute (CSSRI) Karnal

non_saline.action: Normal soil salinity; zero restriction on crop germination

slightly_saline.action: Sensitive crops (pulses, beans) may show yield reduction; ensure good drainage

moderately_saline.action: Yield restriction for most crops; prefer salt-tolerant crops (Barley, Mustard, Cotton)

strongly_saline.action: Severe osmotic stress: install subsurface drainage, flush with good quality irrigation water

S.name: Available Sulphur
S.deficiency_action: Apply Gypsum @ 200-250 kg/ha or elemental sulphur for oilseeds and pulses

Zn.name: Available Zinc
Zn.deficiency_action: Soil application of Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4) @ 25 kg/ha or foliar spray @ 0.5% at vegetative stage

Fe.name: Available Iron
Fe.deficiency_action: Foliar spray of Ferrous Sulphate (FeSO4) @ 0.5% with 0.1% citric acid to alleviate chlorosis

Cu.name: Available Copper
Cu.deficiency_action: Soil application of Copper Sulphate @ 5 kg/ha in deficient peat/sandy soils

Mn.name: Available Manganese
Mn.deficiency_action: Foliar spray of Manganese Sulphate @ 0.5% in high-pH calcareous soils

B.name: Available Boron
B.source: ICAR-IISS Hot Water Soluble Boron Standard
B.deficiency_action: Soil application of Borax @ 10 kg/ha or foliar Solubor @ 0.2% before flowering in pulses/oilseeds

constraints_rules.name: Soil Organic Carbon Depletion
constraints_rules.impact: Impaired soil structure, low biological activity, poor water retention and high drought vulnerability.
constraints_rules.remediation: Incorporate 5-10 t/ha FYM/vermicompost, avoid burning crop residues, and adopt green manuring (Sesbania/Crotalaria).

constraints_rules.name: Soil Acidity Hazard
constraints_rules.applicable_region: Eastern & Western Ghats, Coastal & NE India
constraints_rules.impact: Aluminium and Manganese toxicity, acute phosphorus fixation, suppressed biological nitrogen fixation.
constraints_rules.remediation: Broadcast agricultural lime or dolomite based on lime requirement test; apply rock phosphate with compost.

constraints_rules.name: Alkalinity & Sodic Hazard
constraints_rules.applicable_region: Indo-Gangetic Plains, Deccan Vertisols, Canal Command Areas
constraints_rules.impact: Sodium disperses soil aggregates causing poor aeration, surface crusting, and micronutrient immobilization (Zn, Fe, Mn).
constraints_rules.remediation: Apply gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O) @ 2.5-5 t/ha followed by ponding/leaching; grow Dhaincha (Sesbania aculeata) as green manure.

constraints_rules.name: Salinity Osmotic Stress
constraints_rules.applicable_region: Coastal Regions, Arid & Semi-Arid Irrigated Basins
constraints_rules.impact: Osmotic inhibition of root water uptake, seedling scorching, and nutrient imbalance.
constraints_rules.remediation: Improve field drainage, leach rootzone salts with fresh water, avoid saline borewell irrigation, and select salt-tolerant crops.

constraints_rules.name: Zinc Deficiency Stress
constraints_rules.impact: Stunted vegetative growth, little leaf disorder, reduced auxin synthesis, and 'Khaira' disease in rice.
constraints_rules.remediation: Soil application of Zinc Sulphate (21% Zn) @ 25 kg/ha or foliar spray @ 0.5% (5g/L water) at active tillering/branching.

constraints_rules.name: Boron Deficiency & Reproductive Failure
constraints_rules.impact: Poor pollen viability, flower drop, fruit cracking in pomegranate, and incomplete seed set in mustard/sunflower.
constraints_rules.remediation: Soil application of Borax @ 10 kg/ha or foliar application of 20% Solubor @ 1.0-1.5 g/L prior to flowering.
